Comparison summary (fixed usage basis)

  • Estimated monthly cost: GPT-6.1 Sol ¥218.87 vs GPT-6 Luna ¥11.00 on a common CNY basis (list prices $32.58 / $1.64) — at this fixed usage, GPT-6 Luna is cheaper by ¥207.87/month.
  • Cost ratio: under this basis, GPT-6.1 Sol costs about 19.9× GPT-6 Luna (GPT-6 Luna is ~95% cheaper). The ratio holds only at the current list prices, reference rate and fixed usage assumptions; it says nothing about capability, output quality or overall value.
  • Input unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $2 vs $0.1; after conversion GPT-6 Luna is lower (by ≈ ¥12.76/1M tokens).
  • Output unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $10 vs $0.5; after conversion GPT-6 Luna is lower (by ≈ ¥63.82/1M tokens).
  • Cache-hit price (off-peak basis): GPT-6.1 Sol $0.1; GPT-6 Luna $0.01.
  • Context window: identical at 1050K.
  • Modalities: identical — Text, Image understanding.
  • Price sources: OpenAI API pricing (verified 2026-10-28), OpenAI API pricing (verified 2026-10-28); unit: official list price per 1M tokens (GPT-6.1 Sol in USD, GPT-6 Luna in USD).

These are computations from published list prices under fixed call volume, token usage, cache assumptions and billing rules. They are not rankings of capability, output quality or overall value, and do not constitute purchase advice.
